field_provenance.corpus_oracle_exceeds_sc: boolean: the corpus has selectable headroom (oracle>SC) — the precondition that makes this test informative.
field_provenance.selectable_headroom: oracle - SC on the scored corpus — the room a reranker has to win.
field_provenance.reranker_makes_distinct_selections: boolean: the reranker's selection array differs from SC on >=1 problem — the non-degeneracy de-flag.
field_provenance.strong_sc_accuracy: ranked-voting SC accuracy (held-out) — the STRONG control the energy reranker must beat, reported ONCE.
field_provenance.plurality_sc_accuracy: plurality majority vote (held-out) — the weaker control, for context.
field_provenance.step_aggregation_energy_accuracy: exp3520's step->final aggregation as the reranker scorer (DISTINCT from SC).
field_provenance.pessimistic_bon_energy_accuracy: pessimistic-BoN energy — targets exp3519's wrong-flip failure mode.
field_provenance.mob_accuracy: MoB bootstrapped-mode selection — the strong non-energy alternative.
field_provenance.best_condition: the energy condition with the highest held-out accuracy.
field_provenance.flip_count_best_vs_strong_sc: problems where the best condition differs from the STRONG SC — the tautology-clean primary signal; MUST be > 0.
field_provenance.flips_correct_best: flips that became CORRECT (the win mechanism).
field_provenance.net_correctness_gain_best: flips_correct - flips_incorrect — the honest net effect.
field_provenance.delta_best_vs_strong_sc: best condition minus the STRONG SC at matched compute — THE headline delta.
field_provenance.paired_significance: McNemar exact p + paired bootstrap CI95 for the best-condition delta vs the STRONG SC.
field_provenance.random_seed: determinism; CONTENT-DERIVED, not the experiment number.
field_provenance.reproducibility_checksum: content hash of corpus + reranker config + split + seed.
field_provenance.duration_s: cached scoring + small-model training; 1s floor (no live model).
